message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "AbstractUnArchiver", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "The entryName parameter, tainted from ZipArchiveEntry.getName(), is passed to FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName) and the resulting File f is used directly in new FileOutputStream(f). There is no path normalization, allow-listing, or containment check ensuring f remains under dir, so a name containing ../ or an absolute path can escape the destination directory and write outside it."}]}
